title: sopubia mannii var. tenuifolia
intro: Sopubia mannii var. tenuifolia, commonly known as African blue water lily or African water lily, is a plant species that belongs to the family Orobanchaceae. It is traditionally used in African and Asian folk medicine, offering several health benefits, including the treatment of fever, malaria, and other infectious diseases. The plant is reported to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antimalarial properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The bioactive constituents of Sopubia mannii var. tenuifolia include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its various pharmacological activities.
